messages:
eva_fin: Heads-up  I noticed May's GPU invoice shows $18k of spend assigned across three unrelated projects. looks like tagging drift after last week's onboarding changes.

sam_finops: yikes. Is customer billing affected or just internal allocation?

eva_fin: Mostly allocation noise, but could lead to incorrect customer invoices if we don't fix before the next run.

costbot: BILLING_ALERT: GPU_ALLOCATION_ANOMALY detected (score=0.87) for billing_account: prod-gpu-billing. See /billing/alerts/1833456789. :rotating_light:

luis_cloudops: The new tag-inference heuristic maps untagged VMs by ssh-key-owner then git_repo then project. Shared CI keys likely caused the cross-assignment.

platform_eng: We added that to speed onboarding. Didn't anticipate shared keys causing skew.

sam_finops: Request: produce two provisional reports for May: (A) explicit-tag only allocation, (B) inferred allocation. Finance wants both to present to stakeholders.

luis_cloudops: I'll run backfills for both views and include an inference_confidence column. SQL snippets ready; ETA EOD tomorrow.

platform_eng: I'll add a feature flag to prefer k8s_service_account over ssh-key-owner and can canary it on 3 hosts. Recommend freezing inference changes until reconciliation is done.

eva_fin: Agreed. Mark low-confidence (<0.5) rows as "pending assignment" so we don't auto-bill. If any customer exposure > $5k we'll loop in legal.

sam_finops: Scheduling sync 9:30am PT tomorrow to review provisional allocation and decide on credits.

costbot: NOTE: created ticket BILL-4237 for May GPU re-allocation. Priority: high. Reminder: next bill run closes in 5 business days.
